title: Enterprise IT Strategy and Architecture Roadmap: Target-State Architecture, Legacy System Decommissioning, Investment Priorities, and Business Capability Alignment
subtitle: IT Strategy & Architecture Roadmap — Target State Architecture, Legacy System Decommissioning, Investment Priorities & Business Capability Alignment

document_brief.narrative_theme: By 2028, the enterprise will shift from fragmented legacy platforms to a secure, cloud-first, API-led architecture that accelerates priority business capabilities while funding the transition through disciplined decommissioning and investment governance.
